build_backbone: build a backbone model from a detectron2 config object and optional input shape specification
create_BACKBONE_REGISTRY: create a registry for registering backbone classes that extract feature maps from images
register_backbone: register a backbone class with the BACKBONE_REGISTRY so it can be looked up by name
get_backbone: get a registered backbone class from the BACKBONE_REGISTRY by its name string
build_backbone_from_cfg: build a backbone instance from detectron2 CfgNode configuration and ShapeSpec input shape
